implementation.primitive: One independently factored RFC6386 interval coder. UInt64 holds pending prefix plus eight residual bits. Normalize by exact leading-zero count; publish32bits at a time and backpatch an escaped carry through complete prior bytes. implementation.proof: Pending bits after each write are at most31, before publication at most38. The selected interval stays within its predecessor: at most one carry escapes the pending prefix, and at most47 accumulator bits are needed. All1,048,576 state comparisons and8,192 complete partitions agree with the original bit-by-bit definition;15 native controls also match. The seeded length+packet hash is frozen in the production tests. No imported source or implementation table.
